question: Why is the seedless initiation said to give immediate liberation?
premises: The seedless initiation is called immediate-liberation-giving.
It severs the three bonds of past, future, and begun karma.
Removing those three bonds removes the basis for continued bondage.
inference: Seedless initiation gives immediate liberation because it cuts all three temporal bonds at once.
plain_english: This seedless initiation is said to give immediate liberation, because it cuts away the three bonds of past, future, and already-begun karma.
